explanation: The statement is a very specific "conductor localizes" lemma. It takes an S-algebra map j : B → C, g : B → E and a U-algebra map q : C → E that compose to g. If b multiplies every S-integral element of E into the image of g, then j b does the same for every U-integral element of E, with the image of q in place of the image of g. The proof uses Mathlib's IsIntegral.exists_multiple_integral_of_isLocalization (RingTheory/Localization/Integral.lean:225) plus map_units. That lemma only supplies an ingredient. I searched for that lemma's uses and for related integral and localization lemmas. I found no Mathlib declaration stating this conductor or multiplier-localization property, so no single declaration gives it in one or two lines.
